conditions.page_cache: warm (one untimed warm-up per case), except the `cold` group, which drops the page cache before every sample
conditions.machine: a 2018 laptop: Intel Core i5-8265U (4 cores, 8 threads, 1.6 to 3.9 GHz), 7.4 GiB RAM, NVMe SSD
conditions.load: the test laptop ran one job at a time under a lock; nothing else ran during a timing job

compute_against_references.harness: cig bench, one manifest: each program's .cig (cig run), its CPython and its Node version from cig-compile's bench/ref, each held to the program's .expect; samples 9, per 1, warm-up 1

start_up.name: cig run hello, cold page cache

start_up_profile.command: perf stat -r 20 -e task-clock,page-faults,instructions:u (one round; perf's own overhead is in the elapsed time)

family.command: cig bench --family, every product's main-tree manifest, each product's released binary swapped in with --with
